text: Edmonton have opened 8-1-1 and own the best points percentage in the league at .850, with 47 goals in ten games — 4.70 per outing. Our handicap asks the Oilers only to win by one, so the selection is Edmonton -0.75 at -241. The obvious danger is a hot Toronto goaltending night, and the price already carries that risk.

text: Both teams are 2-0, but Atlanta's two wins both came on the road while Houston have simply held serve at 1-0 at home and 1-0 away. The Hawks get the home floor and a four-point cushion in our handicap, so the selection is Atlanta +4.0 at -240. Houston's start is real, yet a four-point margin either way sits inside the spread this game projects to, and we make Atlanta 58.3% on the money line.

Charlotte are 1-1, with their only home game a defeat and their win coming on the road. Miami are 0-2 and have lost both games at home, leaving them 0-1 in the conference. Our handicap asks the Hornets to win by two, and the selection is Charlotte -2.0 at -248. The Heat have not yet shown a scoring response, so the cushion looks fair rather than generous against a team still hunting a first win.

Cleveland lost their opener on the road and Brooklyn lost theirs at home, so both franchises are chasing a first win. The Cavaliers get home advantage and four points in our line, making Cleveland +4.0 at -240 the selection. Brooklyn's 0-1 record includes a home defeat, and a four-point cushion covers most of the realistic margin range in a game between two teams yet to register.

Philadelphia are 2-0 with one home win and one road win, while Milwaukee are 0-2 and already 0-2 against the conference. Our ratings give the 76ers the widest edge on the board, and the handicap asks them to win by nine: Philadelphia -8.5 at -239. The Bucks have lost both games and are 0-1 on the road, so the cushion is not asking for anything the early table has not already shown.

Denver dropped their opener on the road while New Orleans have lost twice, once at home and once away, leaving them 0-2 overall. The Nuggets get altitude and a 1.5-point cushion, so the play is Denver +1.5 at -243. New Orleans are 0-1 at home and 0-1 on the road, and a 1.5-point cushion in a game we make Denver 66.4% to win is a fair trade at the price.

Pau sit second in the Top 14 after six of the seven round-seven matches were complete, nine places above Toulon in eleventh. The visitors have the stronger table position and our line gives them a 1.25-point cushion: Section Paloise +1.25 at -240. Toulon at home are never a soft touch, which is exactly why the cushion matters more than the outright price of -199 on the Pau win.
